tasks.title: Design schema-driven generator for .d.ts and .d.lua
tasks.description: Design a script that reads schemas/coconut.config.schema.json and generates both coconut.d.ts and coconut.d.lua. Evaluate whether to extend JSON schema with metadata tags (js-only/lua-only/shared) or keep manual sync. Compare config.h, both .d.lua files, and .d.ts to determine which is most up-to-date.
